response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.location) <> '' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_ratio DESC) AS rnk FROM ev) SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk, event_id;

assumptions.assumption: Events with no location are those where location is NULL or blank/whitespace-only; these are excluded.
Budget lines with amount = 0 give a NULL ratio (SQLite division by zero), so AVG ignores them. An event whose lines all have zero amount has a NULL average and is ranked last in its location.
Events with no budget lines are excluded (inner join), as the request says 'for each event that has budget lines'.
